{{Quote|For an ex-farm boy from a hot ''desert world'' like Tatooine... ''Nothing'' could be much more ''uninviting'' than all that ''snow'' and ''ice''!|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="kingdom" />}}
The '''Polar Wastes''' were a region on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Akuria II]]. At some point, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] created a [[Polar Base|base]] here, and [[Akuria Rebel Base|as did]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The natural [[Geyser Sea]] was also located in the Wastes.
